notes: NDM 1.5.3 — the IDM way: clicking Download now opens a small panel right on the video page, with the video thumbnail, title and quality list — pick a quality and the download starts in NDM in the background, without leaving the page. Repeat clicks are instant (probe results are cached for 10 minutes), and a video that is already in your list says so in the panel instead of failing at the end. The in-app dialog flow is unchanged as a fallback.
